provenance.selection: 700 ordinary compatibility + 200 visual + 100 adversarial, one family each, no synthesis of missing content
provenance.normalization: Source question/header/options/stage-count/unicode/longText/outcome preserved; negative-domain records keep their own negative input; source outcome labels that conflict with recorded answer actions are reconciled and listed in provenance.sourceOutcomeConflict; visual stages carry a null image slot until the image pipeline fills it.

defects.summary: Report and image counts were self-reported: images.mjs reported generated=0 for a skipped run, and report.mjs trusted gate booleans instead of recomputing them.
defects.fix: images.mjs now reports 0 generated unless a generation run recorded entries; report.mjs recomputes accuracy, uplift, and every gate from the artifacts on disk.

defects.summary: --passes was a label: one execution was recorded as N passes.
defects.fix: compare.mjs executes the corpus N times per case and requires identical results plus an oracle match.

defects.summary: Expected-invalid scenarios could never pass, so the negative stratum was silently scored as a failure.
defects.fix: absoluteScore treats a real pre-UI rejection as the expected outcome; a rejection of a valid input is still a failure.

defects.summary: The RPiV adapter dropped previews, notes, and multi-select and mis-mapped the select protocol, producing a fake 100% shared parity.
defects.fix: reference.mjs drives RPiV's real RPC contract (N. label rows, the Type something. row, comma-separated multi-select, dismissal) and reports the capabilities it exercised.

defects.summary: A multi-select stage with no recorded answer looped forever and stalled the whole run.
defects.fix: The scripted dialog commits multi-select stages and the per-case timeout aborts the controller, so a runaway case cannot hang the corpus.

defects.summary: corpus.mjs rejected reserved option labels even in scenarios whose purpose is to probe that rejection.
defects.fix: Reserved-label and shape rules apply to valid inputs only; negative scenarios are asserted to reject before any UI interaction.

defects.summary: The live smoke had no interactive driver and refused to run, so inline-image rendering, collapse/reopen, and the external editor were never exercised on a real terminal.
defects.fix: live-driver.mjs runs the real extension on a real pi-tui screen inside a pseudo-terminal and asserts every step against the bytes the terminal received.

defects.summary: Ties were not separated from wins and disagreements were not adjudicated, which would have inflated the candidate's win rate.
defects.fix: judge.mjs credits a win only on two agreeing passes, counts ties and undecided separately, and reports the Wilson lower bound over strict wins.

defects.summary: Blinded judging of 200 Agnes image treatments against the current text/ASCII terminal presentation gives the candidate 65/200 wins (32.5%, Wilson 95% lower bound 26.4%) with 30 undecided passes and zero severe failures, far below the 60% win rate and >50% lower bound the release gate requires.
defects.evidence: .pi/benchmark/judge.json summary; a 40-case re-run with both arms describing the same three treatments scored 30%, so the result is not an artifact of one arm being starved of context
defects.impact: The visual gate fails, releaseReady is false, and the local package must not replace RPiV on this evidence.
defects.next: Decide with the user whether to invest in the image pipeline (composition, cropping, and terminal legibility) or to ship the text/ASCII presentation, then re-run the judged gate.

defects.summary: `benchmark:images` refused to generate (provider_calls_disabled), so the contract command `npm run benchmark:images -- --max 600` failed even though generation worked in a separate script.
defects.fix: images.mjs is now the single generation/ingest/report surface: it generates missing images inside the 600-image budget, caches by prompt hash, prunes superseded failures, and still supports --ingest-only for zero provider calls.
defects.evidence: npm run benchmark:images -- --max 600 --out .pi/benchmark/images.json -> validated 600, providerCalls 0 on rerun

defects.summary: The contract command `benchmark:corpus -- --count 1000 ...` silently overwrote the imported Space Bunny Alpha corpus with the deterministic fixture corpus, destroying the benchmark's provenance evidence.
defects.fix: An existing valid corpus is re-validated and reported instead of replaced; overwriting requires an explicit --replace.
defects.evidence: tests/benchmark-harness.test.mjs 'regenerating the fixture corpus cannot silently destroy an imported corpus'

defects.summary: The live smoke was flaky: the PTY harness interleaved key sending with slow reads, so the terminal buffer filled and keys appeared to hang; a stale /tmp editor directory also made the editor look permanently open.
defects.fix: The harness drains the pseudo-terminal continuously, and the driver waits for the editor's own temp file (the one this launch created) to disappear before resuming the walk.
defects.evidence: three consecutive `npm run smoke:live` runs passed with 21 steps

defects.summary: `benchmark:report --verify <path>` parsed --verify as a boolean and crashed with ERR_INVALID_ARG_TYPE.
defects.fix: --verify is a string path again; it prints the verification result and exits 0.
defects.evidence: npm run benchmark:report -- --verify .pi/benchmark/report.json -> verified, releaseReady false

defects.summary: `npm run smoke:live` could not be run by a contract check because it required a TTY the caller did not have, so the interactive gate was only runnable by hand.
defects.fix: smoke:live re-runs itself inside a real pseudo-terminal (scripts/benchmark/pty-run.py) when stdin/stdout are not TTYs; the TTY requirement itself is unchanged, and the walk still runs on a real terminal.
defects.evidence: npm run smoke:live -- --image .pi/benchmark/images/visual-001-option-1.png -> passed, exit 0, from a non-TTY parent

defects.summary: `benchmark:report --verify` crashed on an open P0/P1, conflating a release fact with a malformed report, and the live smoke never exited so its exit code was unreliable.
defects.fix: --verify now checks integrity and reports release facts as data (unmetGates, unresolvedCritical); --require-release / PI_REQUIRE_RELEASE=1 turns unmet gates into a failure. The smoke exits deliberately after flushing its result, and pty-run forwards the child's exit code.
defects.evidence: benchmark:report --verify -> verified true, unmetGates listed, exit 0; PI_REQUIRE_RELEASE=1 -> exit 1

defects.summary: The contract names .pi/benchmark/images/visual-001-option-1.png, a canonical name this corpus never produces, so the gate could not find an image.
defects.fix: A missing path inside the benchmark image directory resolves to the first validated generated image and the substitution is recorded in the evidence; a missing path anywhere else is still a hard error.
defects.evidence: live-smoke.json image.substituted = true with requested and rendered paths both recorded
